title: Assessments and linked run outcomes use source observations
description: Use the actual private actor and pre-client assessment store fixtures. Prove feedback, independent run deletion, read-error Retry, a quiet mounted panel and the real retention boundary. No provider or worker execution; no client-state injection.

proofTargets.claim: Actual independent feedback updates mounted assessment history, detail and summary without Refresh.
Deleting the actual associated run updates the mounted outcome from a canonical run observation.
An actual outcome read error exposes contextual Retry and its real query is retried.
The mounted assessment panel issues no periodic reads for longer than the former 15-second poll.
A pre-client record expires through its owning clock deadline; mounted history and summary update with no write or source-file change.

prove.intent: Prove mounted assessment and run-source observations on the isolated gateway.
